prompt: Name someone who signed the United States Declaration of Independence.

answers.name: John Hancock
answers.fact: President of the Congress and the first to sign, in a hand nearly five inches wide.

answers.name: Thomas Jefferson
answers.fact: Drafted it in about seventeen days, then sat through Congress cutting roughly a quarter of it.

answers.name: Benjamin Franklin
answers.fact: At seventy, the oldest of the fifty-six.

answers.name: John Adams
answers.fact: Sat on the committee of five and argued the case for independence on the floor.

answers.name: Samuel Adams
answers.fact: A Boston organiser of the resistance, and John's second cousin.

answers.name: Roger Sherman
answers.fact: The only person to sign the Continental Association, the Declaration, the Articles of Confederation and the Constitution.

answers.name: Richard Henry Lee
answers.fact: Introduced the resolution for independence that the Declaration was written to justify.

answers.name: Robert Morris
answers.fact: Financed much of the war and died bankrupt.

answers.name: Elbridge Gerry
answers.fact: Later a vice president, and the source of the word gerrymander.

answers.name: Charles Carroll
answers.fact: The only Catholic signer, and the last of the fifty-six to die, in 1832.

answers.name: Caesar Rodney
answers.fact: Rode overnight from Delaware through a thunderstorm to break his delegation's tie.

answers.name: Button Gwinnett
answers.fact: Killed in a duel within the year, which is why his signature is among the rarest in American collecting.

answers.name: Stephen Hopkins
answers.fact: Had palsy, and is said to have remarked that his hand trembled but his heart did not.

answers.name: William Ellery
answers.fact: Said he watched each man's face as he signed, looking for fear.

answers.name: Abraham Clark
answers.fact: A New Jersey surveyor whose two sons were captured and held on a British prison ship.
